Use the universal property of `PiTensorProduct`; both conjuncts are determined by their behavior on pure tensors `tprod R f`.

- For the first conjunct, unfold the defining computation rule for `PiTensorProduct.lift`: the linear map induced by a multilinear map `φ` sends `tprod R f` exactly to `φ f`.

- For the second, apply extensionality for linear maps out of `PiTensorProduct`. On a pure tensor, `PiTensorProduct.map` acts componentwise, so mapping by the family of identity linear maps gives
  \[
  \operatorname{tprod}(i \mapsto \mathrm{id}(f_i))=\operatorname{tprod}(f).
  \]
  The identity endomorphism has the same value, hence the two linear maps agree on all pure tensors and therefore everywhere.

Thus the proof is organized around the computation lemmas for `lift` and `map` on `tprod`, followed by tensor-product extensionality.
